note: The column holds the all-in coupon. The interest_rate tag sits in the cell for every '#%' row, and n1 equals it on all 3813 rows. In '#% (incl. #% PIK)', n1 is the all-in rate and n2 equals the tagged pik_rate on all 73 rows. In '#% PIK', n1 equals the tagged pik_rate on all 45 rows, so the whole rate is PIK. No codes appear in this column.
